summary: The completed frozen-A2 trials confirm an execution-mode effect but do not meet the Zone 2 gate: deterministic play remained on Floor 1; both reproducible stochastic streams reached Floor 2 on seeds 57004, 57005, and 57009; one stream reached Floor 3 on seed 57019; none reached Zone 2. The active continuation evaluation was mistakenly interrupted after its owned game workers were queried under the wrong executable name, so EXP-0009 is incomplete operator-aborted diagnostic evidence rather than a full checkpoint comparison or a launcher failure. Argmax collapse is not the sole demonstrated progression blocker; retain A2 and Reward V2 as the measured baseline while correcting learning integrity.
